Authentication is not required to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within Sun Directory Server's LDAP implementation and can be triggered via a malformed LDAP query to the ns_slapd service. When the service decodes the malformed extendedRequest query containing a malformed requestValue string, the application will cause a buffer overflow which can lead to code execution under the context of the service.
